htm
===

Package:  htm
Version:  3.1.1
License:  Apache-2.0 (see ./LICENSE)
Author:   Jason Miller <https://github.com/developit/htm>
Source:   https://esm.sh/htm@3.1.1/es2022/htm.mjs
Vendored: 2026-07-27

WHY VENDORED
------------
Same reason as ../preact: it was imported from esm.sh at runtime, which broke
offline boot (sw.js never caches cross-origin), tripped the page's COEP
require-corp posture, and put a third party in the path of every visit.

EXPORTS USED
------------
  default        (app/state.js: export const html = htm.bind(h))

htm is the tagged-template layer over preact's h() — it is what lets the ⚙
panel be written as html`<div>...</div>` with no build step and no JSX
transform. That "no bundler" property is the reason this project uses it, so
vendoring it costs 1.2 KB and keeps the property.

ONE MODIFICATION — the trailing `//# sourceMappingURL=htm.js.map` line was
removed, for the reason given in ../preact/VERSION.txt: we ship no .map files,
so the reference only sent devtools hunting for a file that is not there.

Otherwise the esm.sh es2022 build byte-for-byte. Self-contained: imports
nothing.

RENAMED .mjs -> .js
-------------------
Upstream ships htm.mjs; we serve htm.js, because nginx does not map .mjs and
served it as application/octet-stream, which a browser will not accept as a
module. See ../preact/VERSION.txt.
